description: AI & privacy gateway: the protocol of data flows from connected products to AI — time, product, tool, data classes seen, action (passed, pseudonymised, removed, blocked, rules_changed), counts and model route; never any contents. Filters: provider, tool, action, from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), limit (max 500), offset. Tenant admins only.

action.description: Only entries with this gateway action

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

offset.description: Number of entries to skip (for paging)

provider.description: Only data flows from this connected product

tool.description: Only data flows from this tool

name: ai_privacy_log
